svg.title: Anthropic shares earmarked for public benefit, as announced October 18, 2026
svg.desc: A horizontal bar on a scale of 0 to 30 percent of Anthropic's shares. The first segment, 5 percent, is the new Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, committed subject to stockholder approval. The second segment, about 15 percent, is the co-founders' pledge to donate 80 percent of their equity plus the employee equity donation match, in which about half of staff take part; Anthropic gives only the combined total of roughly 20 percent and does not split it. Dashed segments after 20 percent show the Fund growing by 2 percent at the board's discretion for each 50 percent rise in company value above a baseline that has not been disclosed. Notes: the Fund is a wholly owned LLC, not a 501(c)(3); its equity may not be used for lobbying or political giving; governance details are due in the coming months.
svg.text: Anthropic equity earmarked for public benefit (announced Oct 18)
Share of Anthropic's stock. Scale: 0–30%. 1 percentage point = 28 px.
5% now, subject to stockholder approval. Wholly owned LLC, not a 501(c)(3). No lobbying or political giving.
Co-founders' 80%-of-equity pledge + employee donation match (≈half of staff)
Anthropic gives only the combined ≈20% total, so the ≈15% here is that total minus the Fund.
Board's discretion, for each 50% rise above a baseline not yet disclosed. Three steps drawn for illustration only.
